agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has a single free body with high horizontal speed (vx~13.7) and no explicit walls. The engine splits integration into 5 substeps but applies no arena-boundary collision (no walls to collide with), so the body translates beyond x=20−r under gravity alone. By step 139 it is already near the limit (overshoot 0.058) and at step 140 x≈19.329 exceeds the 0.15 in_arena tolerance (overshoot 0.159). Reducing vx removes the escape, confirming speed+missing boundary enforcement is causal.
